title: TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the laboratory manager office (O21) in The Lab.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key (TGL MO) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the TerraGroup Labs manager office.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can unlock two separate doors leading to the same office.
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a possible location for the quest Following the Bread Crumbs

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- Room O13 on a lit up desk, left of the glass door entrance

- In room O22, in the conference room on the right side of the powered laptop

- Y11 (the parking garage) sitting on the passenger side seat of the SUV that has the Weapon box (6x2) in the trunk

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Laboratory manager office (O21) on the second level in The Lab.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- Blue keycard spawn location
- 2x PC block
- 1x Drawer
- 1x Safe
- 1x Weapon box (6x4)
- 4x Valuables spawns
- Intelligence folder spawn on the desk
